verses.decoded: In the same way, these people have not believed either, so that by your mercy they too may receive mercy.

verses.kjv: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
verses.decoded: God has locked everyone into unbelief so that he can show mercy to everyone.

verses.kjv: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
verses.decoded: Oh, how deep are the riches of God's wisdom and knowledge! His decisions are beyond understanding, and His ways cannot be fully discovered.

verses.kjv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
verses.decoded: Who has ever understood the mind of the Lord? Or who has given Him advice?

verses.kjv: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
verses.decoded: Who has ever given anything to God first, so that God would owe them something in return?

verses.kjv: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
verses.decoded: Everything comes from Him, exists through Him, and is meant for Him. To Him be glory forever. Amen.

verses.kjv: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
verses.decoded: Therefore, brothers and sisters, because of God's mercy, I urge you to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God—this is your true and proper worship.

verses.kjv: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
verses.decoded: Do not follow the patterns of this world, but let your mind be renewed and changed so that you can understand and live out God's good, pleasing, and perfect will.

verses.kjv: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
verses.decoded: Because of the grace God has given me, I tell everyone not to think too highly of themselves but to have a humble and realistic view, based on the faith God has given each person.

verses.kjv: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
verses.decoded: Just as a body has many parts, each with a different function,

verses.kjv: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
verses.decoded: we, though many, are one body in Christ and belong to each other.

verses.kjv: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
verses.decoded: We have different gifts given by God's grace. If your gift is prophecy, use it in accordance with your faith.

verses.kjv: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
verses.decoded: If your gift is serving, serve well; if you teach, teach well;

verses.kjv: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.
verses.decoded: If you encourage others, do so sincerely; if you give, do it generously; if you lead, do it diligently; if you show kindness, do it cheerfully.

verses.kjv: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
verses.decoded: Let love be genuine. Hate what is evil; hold tightly to what is good.

verses.kjv: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
verses.decoded: Be devoted to one another with brotherly love. Honor others above yourselves.

verses.kjv: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
verses.decoded: Never be lazy, but work hard and be passionate in serving the Lord.

verses.kjv: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
verses.decoded: Be joyful because of your hope, patient when troubles come, and faithful in prayer.

verses.kjv: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
verses.decoded: Share with those in need and be eager to show hospitality.

verses.kjv: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
verses.decoded: Bless those who persecute you; don’t curse them.

verses.kjv: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
verses.decoded: Be happy with those who are happy, and share the sadness of those who are sad.

verses.kjv: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
verses.decoded: Live in harmony with each other. Don’t think you are better than others, but be willing to associate with those of humble status. Don’t be proud or think too highly of yourself.

verses.kjv: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
verses.decoded: Don’t repay anyone evil for evil. Always do what is right and honorable in the eyes of everyone.

verses.kjv: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
verses.decoded: As far as you can, live peacefully with everyone.

verses.kjv: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: Dear friends, don’t take revenge on others. Instead, leave room for God’s anger, because the Lord says, ‘I will take revenge; I will repay.’

verses.kjv: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
verses.decoded: If your enemy is hungry, feed them; if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. By doing this, you will make them feel ashamed.

verses.kjv: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.decoded: Don’t let evil defeat you; instead, defeat evil by doing good.

verses.kjv: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.
verses.decoded: Everyone must submit to the authorities above them. There is no authority except from God, and the authorities that exist have been established by God.

verses.kjv: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
verses.decoded: So, anyone who opposes the authorities is opposing what God has set, and those who do so will bring judgment on themselves.

verses.kjv: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:
verses.decoded: Rulers are meant to punish wrongdoers, not those who do good. So, if you do what is right, you have nothing to fear and will be respected by the authorities.

verses.kjv: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
verses.decoded: The ruler is God's servant to help you when you do good. But if you do wrong, you should be afraid, because the ruler carries the sword to punish wrongdoers as God's agent of justice.

verses.kjv: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
verses.decoded: Therefore, you must submit not only to avoid punishment but also because it is the right thing to do in your conscience.

verses.kjv: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God’s ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
verses.decoded: This is why you also pay taxes, because the authorities serve God by governing and maintaining order.

verses.kjv: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
verses.decoded: Give everyone what you owe them: pay taxes to those who collect taxes, respect to those who deserve respect, and honor to those who deserve honor.

verses.kjv: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
verses.decoded: Do not owe anyone anything except to love one another. Loving others fulfills the requirements of the law.

verses.kjv: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.decoded: The commandments like 'Do not commit adultery,' 'Do not kill,' 'Do not steal,' 'Do not lie,' and 'Do not covet' are all summed up in this one rule: Love your neighbor as yourself.

verses.kjv: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
verses.decoded: Love does no harm to others, so loving others is the complete fulfillment of the law.

verses.kjv: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
verses.decoded: You should understand the times and realize that it is urgent to wake up from spiritual sleep because our salvation is now closer than when we first believed.

verses.kjv: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
verses.decoded: The night is almost over and the day is near, so let’s get rid of sinful behaviors and put on the protection of living in the light.

verses.kjv: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
verses.decoded: Let us live properly, like people who belong to the daytime—not in wild parties, drunkenness, sexual immorality, quarreling, or jealousy.

verses.kjv: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
verses.decoded: Instead, clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ and don’t plan to satisfy the desires of your sinful nature.

verses.kjv: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
verses.decoded: Accept those who have weak faith, but don’t argue over their doubts.

verses.kjv: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
verses.decoded: Some believe they can eat anything, while others, who are weaker in faith, only eat vegetables.

verses.kjv: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
verses.decoded: Don’t look down on those who don’t eat certain foods, and don’t judge those who do, because God accepts them both.

verses.kjv: Who art thou that judgest another man’s servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
verses.decoded: Who are you to judge someone else’s servant? They stand or fall before their own master, and God can support them.

verses.kjv: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
verses.decoded: Some consider certain days more special than others, while others treat every day the same. Each person should be fully convinced in their own mind.

verses.kjv: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
verses.decoded: If someone observes a special day, they do it for the Lord; if not, they don’t. If someone eats, they eat for the Lord and thank God; if they don’t eat, they also thank God.

verses.kjv: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
verses.decoded: No one lives or dies just for themselves.

verses.kjv: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord’s.
verses.decoded: Whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.

verses.kjv: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
verses.decoded: Christ died and rose again so that He might be Lord over both the living and the dead.

verses.kjv: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
verses.decoded: Why do you judge or look down on your brother? We will all stand before Christ’s judgment seat.

verses.kjv: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
verses.decoded: As the Lord says, ‘I am alive, and every knee will bow to me, and every tongue will confess to God.’

verses.kjv: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
verses.decoded: So each of us will give an account of ourselves to God.

verses.kjv: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother’s way.
verses.decoded: So don’t judge each other anymore; instead, make sure you don’t cause your brother to stumble or fall.

verses.kjv: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
verses.decoded: I am convinced, as the Lord Jesus taught me, that nothing is unclean by itself; but if someone thinks something is unclean, then it is unclean to them.

verses.kjv: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
verses.decoded: But if your brother is hurt by what you eat, you are not acting in love. Don’t harm the one Christ died for by your eating.

verses.kjv: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
verses.decoded: So don’t let your good actions be criticized or cause others to stumble.

verses.kjv: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
verses.decoded: The kingdom of God isn’t about food or drink, but about living righteously, having peace, and experiencing joy through the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
verses.decoded: Anyone who serves Christ by pursuing these qualities is pleasing to God and respected by others.

verses.kjv: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
verses.decoded: So let’s strive for things that promote peace and help build each other up.

verses.kjv: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
verses.decoded: Food itself does not ruin God’s work; everything is clean, but it is wrong for someone to eat if it causes another person to be hurt or offended.

verses.kjv: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
verses.decoded: It’s better not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything that might cause your brother to stumble, be offended, or become weak in faith.

verses.kjv: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
verses.decoded: If you have faith, keep it between you and God. Blessed is the person who does not doubt themselves for what they approve.

verses.kjv: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
verses.decoded: But if someone doubts and eats anyway, they are guilty because they are not acting in faith; anything done without faith is sin.

verses.kjv: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
verses.decoded: Those of us who are strong should support the weaknesses of others and not just focus on pleasing ourselves.

verses.kjv: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
verses.decoded: Each of us should try to please our neighbors in a way that benefits and builds them up.

verses.kjv: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.
verses.decoded: Christ did not seek to please Himself, but as the Scriptures say, He took on the insults meant for God.

verses.kjv: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
verses.decoded: Everything written in the past was meant to teach us, so that through patience and encouragement from the Scriptures, we can have hope.

verses.kjv: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:
verses.decoded: May the God who gives patience and encouragement help you to be united in thought and purpose, following the example of Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: So that together, with one voice and one mind, you may glorify God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.
verses.decoded: Therefore, accept one another just as Christ accepted us, bringing glory to God.

verses.kjv: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
verses.decoded: I say that Jesus Christ served the Jewish people to show God’s truth and to confirm the promises made to their ancestors.

verses.kjv: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
verses.decoded: And so that the Gentiles would praise God for His mercy, as the Scriptures say, 'I will praise you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.'

verses.kjv: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
verses.decoded: Again it says, 'Rejoice, Gentiles, along with God’s people.'

verses.kjv: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
verses.decoded: Again it says, 'Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles; and all people, praise Him.'

verses.kjv: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.
verses.decoded: Isaiah also says, 'A descendant of Jesse will rise to rule over the Gentiles, and the Gentiles will put their hope in him.'

verses.kjv: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
verses.decoded: May the God of hope fill you with joy and peace as you trust in Him, so that you overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
verses.decoded: I am confident, my brothers and sisters, that you are full of goodness, have complete understanding, and are able to encourage and correct each other.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,
verses.decoded: But brothers and sisters, I have written more boldly to you in some ways to remind you, because God has given me grace to do this.

verses.kjv: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.
verses.decoded: I serve as a minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, sharing God's gospel so that their offering may be acceptable, made holy by the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.
verses.decoded: Because of this, I have reason to boast in Jesus Christ about what concerns God.

verses.kjv: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
verses.decoded: I won’t claim to speak about anything Christ hasn’t accomplished through me to bring the Gentiles to obedience, both by what I say and do.

verses.kjv: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
verses.decoded: By powerful signs and miracles, through the Spirit of God’s power, I have preached the gospel of Christ everywhere from Jerusalem to Illyricum.

verses.kjv: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man’s foundation:
verses.decoded: I have tried to preach the gospel only where Christ was not already known, so I wouldn’t be building on someone else’s work.

verses.kjv: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
verses.decoded: As the Scripture says, those who have never heard about him will see, and those who have never heard will understand.

verses.kjv: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
verses.decoded: Because of this, I have often been prevented from visiting you.

verses.kjv: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
verses.decoded: But now that I have no more work in these regions, and I have long wanted to visit you,

verses.kjv: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
verses.decoded: Whenever I travel to Spain, I plan to visit you on the way, hoping to be accompanied by you if I first receive some support from you.

verses.kjv: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
verses.decoded: But right now, I am going to Jerusalem to serve the believers there.

verses.kjv: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: The believers in Macedonia and Achaia have gladly given a gift to help the poor Christians in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
verses.decoded: This pleases them because they owe it to the Jerusalem believers. Since the Gentiles have shared in their spiritual blessings, they should also help them with material needs.

verses.kjv: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
verses.decoded: After I have completed this task and delivered this gift, I will visit you on my way to Spain.

verses.kjv: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
verses.decoded: I am confident that when I visit you, I will come with the full blessings of the gospel of Christ.

verses.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ’s sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, I urge you, for the sake of Jesus Christ and the love of the Spirit, to join me in praying earnestly to God on my behalf.

verses.kjv: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
verses.decoded: I pray that I will be protected from those who refuse to believe in Judea, and that the work I am doing for the believers in Jerusalem will be welcomed.

verses.kjv: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.
verses.decoded: I hope to visit you happily, if it is God's will, and to be refreshed together with you.

verses.kjv: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
verses.decoded: May the God who gives peace be with all of you. Amen.

verses.kjv: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
verses.decoded: I recommend to you our sister Phoebe, who serves the church in Cenchrea.

verses.kjv: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
verses.decoded: Welcome her in the Lord as is fitting for God's people, and help her in any way she needs, because she has helped many, including me.

verses.kjv: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:
verses.decoded: Say hello to Priscilla and Aquila, my coworkers in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
verses.decoded: They risked their lives for me. I thank them, and so do all the Gentile churches.

verses.kjv: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my well-beloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.
verses.decoded: Also greet the church that meets in their home. Say hello to my dear friend Epaenetus, the first believer from Achaia to follow Christ.

verses.kjv: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
verses.decoded: Say hello to Mary, who worked very hard for us.

verses.kjv: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
verses.decoded: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and fellow prisoners. They are well known among the apostles and were believers before I was.

verses.kjv: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.
verses.decoded: Say hello to Amplias, my dear friend in the Lord.

verses.kjv: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
verses.decoded: Greet Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys, my dear friend.

verses.kjv: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus’ household.
verses.decoded: Say hello to Apelles, who is tested and approved in Christ. Greet those who belong to Aristobulus' household.

verses.kjv: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
verses.decoded: Greet Herodion, my relative. Also say hello to those in Narcissus' household who belong to the Lord.

verses.kjv: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
verses.decoded: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Also greet dear Persis, who has worked very hard for the Lord.

verses.kjv: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
verses.decoded: Say hello to Rufus, chosen by the Lord, and to his mother, who is like a mother to me too.

verses.kjv: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.
verses.decoded: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and all the believers with them.

verses.kjv: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
verses.decoded: Say hello to Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, Olympas, and all the believers with them.

verses.kjv: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.
verses.decoded: Greet each other with a holy kiss. The churches that belong to Christ send their greetings to you.

verses.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, I urge you to watch out for those who cause divisions and create obstacles that go against the teaching you have received; stay away from them.

verses.kjv: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
verses.decoded: Those people do not serve our Lord Jesus Christ but their own selfish desires; they use flattering words to deceive those who are easily influenced.

verses.kjv: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
verses.decoded: Your obedience has become known to everyone. I am happy because of this, but I want you to be wise about what is good and innocent when it comes to evil.

verses.kjv: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
verses.decoded: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

verses.kjv: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
verses.decoded: Timothy, my coworker, and Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives, send you their greetings.

verses.kjv: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
verses.decoded: I, Tertius, who wrote this letter, send you greetings in the Lord.

verses.kjv: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
verses.decoded: Gaius, my host and also a leader of the whole church, sends you greetings. Erastus, the city treasurer, and Quartus, a brother in Christ, also greet you.

verses.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.decoded: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you. Amen.

verses.kjv: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
verses.decoded: Now to the one who has the power to strengthen you according to my gospel and the message about Jesus Christ, revealed as a mystery that was hidden for ages,

verses.kjv: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
verses.decoded: But now this mystery has been revealed and made known through the prophets’ scriptures, by the command of the eternal God, to bring faith and obedience to all nations.

verses.kjv: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
verses.decoded: To the only wise God be glory forever through Jesus Christ. Amen. (This letter to the Romans was written from Corinth and sent by Phoebe, a servant of the church in Cenchrea.)
